content.value: An 8 bit data 00111001 is passed and written in memory. After that when reading we get (10) 00111101 (bit position 3 is changed). How you detect and correct this one bit error using Hamming code?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
